in_sanskrit.name: यज्ञवत्

in_marathi.name: Yagyavat
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Performer of Yajna
in_marathi.long_meaning: Yagyavat हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Yagyavat is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Yajna', which means 'sacrifice or devotion'. It symbolizes one who performs Yajnas or rituals with utmost devotion and dedication.
